## What's new: your agent hears when your Launcher build ends, and when its lighting is out of date

- **Out-of-date lighting is called out.** After a link, the game watch says when your map's lighting was baked before its last compile: a light, an emissive model or a probe you changed won't show in game until you run Light again. It says so once per bake.
- **Your agent hears each Launcher link end.** A link that built says so in one short line that names only the warnings and missing assets the last link didn't have. An agent waiting on your build knows it's done, without reading the same warning every time.
- **Links and compiles that stop are caught.** A Launcher link or compile that stops before it finishes (a script that won't compile, a crash, a stop) now reaches your agent, with where to find its error.
- **The game watch stays out of your way.** In a session opened outside your BO3 folder it no longer wakes your agent. When it can't watch, it says why. It stops with the session, and shows as "BO3 game, builds, Radiant".
- **t7kb leaves memory to the game.** Each session's t7kb server starts at about 20 MB instead of 1.2 GB, loads what a call needs, and gives it back after 10 minutes without a call. The first search after that takes a few seconds.
- **Skills:** your agent tells you once when t7kb's MCP server isn't set up, instead of quietly using the command line. An effect needs its `#precache` even when the Launcher's run plays it without one. `.ai_*` files need CRLF line endings.
- No change to the database or the Radiant bridge.
